notes.title: Patch 1.03 – Now available
notes.notes:
Language & General Improvement Update

Language

 Added German localization (text and speech)


Gameplay

 Batteries have been put into boxes that are easier to see
 Flashlight battery location changed
 Welding tool has been repositioned


User Experience

 Interactable objects are more consistently highlighted
 Haptic feedback optimized
 Highlight for distance grab has been improved for making it more precise


Atmosphere

 Storage room has been rearranged
 Workshop area has been rearranged
 Added more openable objects for more environment interactivity


Fixes

 Flashlight cone has been refined and a flicker has been added upon activation for better atmosphere
 Fixed decal issue that would project decals on objects being too close
 Fixed issue with button animations


Performance

 General performance improvements


Misc

 Added game version to main menu
